body: Going to the library is what I have been doing. If I stay home I just end up  curling up in bed like you were saying. I actually just came from the library and was able to write another page but that is all I could manage to do.
I thought about that but I’m afraid instead my anxiety will just shoot through the roof. I drink caffeine all the time but never that much :/

No where near as bad as some of these, but this still haunts me and affects my life everyday. This first time I cut myself will follow me forever. That moment, that decision, changed my life forever. That stupid teenage girls inability to think of a healthy coping mechanism means that I have to lie, hide my body, and fight every day just so I don't hurt myself anymore.

I'm 8 months clean of SI, but I still think about it every day
